title: Java Full Stack Development
summary: Build production-style web applications with Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs and React.
overview: A structured, project-led programme for learners who want a strong foundation in backend engineering and modern frontend delivery. You will move from programming fundamentals to a deployed capstone with weekly instructor feedback.

curriculum.description: Collections, generics, streams and resilient error handling.

curriculum.assignment: Refactor a legacy service with streams.

curriculum.title: SQL & JDBC

curriculum.description: Resource design, validation, pagination and API documentation.

curriculum.title: JPA & Hibernate
curriculum.description: Entities, relationships, queries and migration strategy.

curriculum.title: React & TypeScript
curriculum.description: Components, forms, routing and typed client state.

curriculum.title: Authentication & Testing
curriculum.description: Sessions, authorization, unit tests and integration checks.
curriculum.assignment: Add protected routes and test coverage.

curriculum.title: Deployment & Capstone
curriculum.description: Docker, CI basics, observability and production handoff.

curriculum.title: Interview Preparation
curriculum.description: Portfolio walkthroughs, Java problem solving and communication.
